description: Pin of the Claude Code CLI by bytes, not by version string (compromise C2; research/compromises-20261021/FIXES.md action 2; research/engine-20261021/ENGINE-BUMP.md section 4). src/cli-pin.mjs resolveCli() accepts only a binary at .foundry/cli/<sha256>/claude whose sha256 (and size) equal this platform's entry; scripts/fetch-cli.mjs fetches and verifies it. A null sha256 means the pin is not acquired for that platform and resolveCli refuses (CLI_UNPINNED) rather than falling back to PATH.
